goal: Stop RPC and REST endpoints from falsely reporting confirmed transactions as missing when disk reads fail
Properly report index corruption and I/O failures instead of returning empty results
Distinguish pruned or still-downloading blocks from transactions that truly do not exist
agreement: Strong support for distinguishing missing transactions from internal read failures (yuvicc, musaHaruna)
Verified index corruption handling through testing (musaHaruna)
Earlier objection about pruned block error messages was resolved (yuvicc)
Approval after release notes clarifying error behavior were added (enirox001)

categories.name: indexes
why: P2 because silent read errors previously caused callers to treat index corruption as missing data
Surfacing disk failures directly alerts node operators to potential system corruption

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because API callers were falsely told confirmed transactions did not exist during disk failures
Endpoints now reliably report block availability and internal read errors
